function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time data access. I can’t look up the current temperature in Riga right now. However, you can quickly check a reliable weather website or app (like Weather.com, AccuWeather, or your phone’s weather widget) for the most up‑to‑date information.
message.reasoning: The user asks "How hot is it now in Riga?" They want current temperature. We need to provide weather info. There's no tool for weather. According to policy, we can use external API or web search. But we don't have direct access. We could say we can't fetch real-time data. So we should respond that I cannot provide real-time weather.
